integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the full-plane Jacobian from an analytic logarithm, proves the exact disk maximum of Re(z/(1-z^4)), and derives global injectivity from strict monotonicity on connected vertical fibers. The source real-axis formula is recovered as a consistency check, and Lewy's theorem is used only to rule out any larger centered univalence disk after the Jacobian zero enters its interior.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies centered-disk univalence only for Borovikov's explicit vertical-shear family F_M. It does not determine the universal harmonic Landau radius at finite M, does not optimize over arbitrary subdomains, and does not extend the vertical-fiber argument to general harmonic mappings.
title: Exact centered univalence radius of the Borovikov shear
